builds.name: Balance (PvP, model)
builds.summary: Model build for Balance PvP: the report's model pick for this slot. Not a community standard.
about: 41 points in Balance, with 10 in Restoration. Built for PvP. On this order the key talents arrive as follows: Insect Swarm at 25, Moonkin Form at 40, Nature's Splendor at 51 and Nature's Grace at 57.
In the model's rotation it keeps Moonfire and Insect Swarm up and fills with Starfire.
Against the class's best build in each scenario at level 60 it is strongest at questing speed (100%) and dungeon damage (100%), and weakest at raid damage (92%).
A model build: the calculator's pick for this slot, not yet tried in game.

builds.name: Balance Moonkin (PvE)
builds.summary: Balance with Moonkin Form, Insect Swarm, Eclipse, Nature's Grace, Vengeance and Moonfury; Nature's Focus, Naturalist and Reflection from Restoration. The community's caster damage standard.
about: 36 points in Balance, with 15 in Restoration. Built for PvE. On this order the key talents arrive as follows: Nature's Splendor at 24, Insect Swarm at 25, Moonkin Form at 40 and Nature's Grace at 57.
In the model's rotation it keeps Moonfire and Insect Swarm up and fills with Starfire.
At level 60 it scores at or near the top of the class in raid damage, questing speed and dungeon damage.

builds.name: Feral Bear (PvE)
builds.summary: Feral with Thick Hide, Natural Reaction, Primal Bite and Leader of the Pack: the community's bear tank build (routes only, unscored).
about: 42 points in Feral Combat, with 9 in Balance. Built for PvE. On this order the key talents arrive as follows: Leader of the Pack at 30, Feral Charge at 51, Primal Bite at 52 and Berserk at 60.
A healing or tanking build: the tool has no healing or threat model yet, so it has no rotation or scores here, only the talent order.

builds.name: Feral Cat (PvP)
builds.summary: Feral cat with Feral Charge, Feral Swiftness, Shredding Attacks, Berserk and Rend and Tear; Genesis and Nature's Majesty from Balance and Furor from Restoration. Mobility and burst from stealth: the community's most saved Feral build.
about: 34 points in Feral Combat, with 9 in Balance and 5 in Restoration. Built for PvP. On this order the key talents arrive as follows: Feral Charge at 29, Leader of the Pack at 30 and Berserk at 54.
Fights in Cat Form, building combo points with Shred for finishers. Damage comes from auto-attacks 55% and abilities 45%.
Against the class's best build in each scenario at level 60 it is strongest at raid damage (80%) and questing speed (69%), and weakest at dungeon damage (59%).

builds.name: Restoration (PvP)
builds.summary: 51 points (Balance 0 / Feral Combat 20 / Restoration 31). Heart of the Wild is one of the spent talents. From the site's Restoration Druid · Endgame · PvP · level 60 plan.
about: 31 points in Restoration, with 20 in Feral Combat. Built for PvP. On this order the key talents arrive as follows: Gift of the Earthmother at 44, Swiftmend at 49, Feral Charge at 50, Nature's Swiftness at 51 and Wild Growth at 60.
A healing or tanking build: the tool has no healing or threat model yet, so it has no rotation or scores here, only the talent order.

builds.name: Restoration (PvE)
builds.summary: Restoration with Swiftmend, Nature's Swiftness, Wild Growth and Gift of Nature; Genesis and Moonglow from Balance. The most saved druid build: the community's healer standard (routes only, unscored).
about: 35 points in Restoration, with 11 in Balance and 5 in Feral Combat. Built for PvE. On this order the key talents arrive as follows: Nature's Splendor at 43, Gift of the Earthmother at 44, Swiftmend at 48, Nature's Swiftness at 49 and Wild Growth at 60.
A healing or tanking build: the tool has no healing or threat model yet, so it has no rotation or scores here, only the talent order.

caveats: Balance (#166): Moonfire and Insect Swarm kept up, then Starfire or Wrath on the caster engine; Eclipse, Nature's Grace and Omen of Clarity aren't modeled. Feral cat (#175): paw swings and a Shred or Claw to Ferocious Bite energy cycle on the melee engine, Classic paw damage; Rake and Rip bleeds, Tiger's Fury and powershifting aren't modeled. The bear tank and Restoration stay unscored. Base stats are estimates.
